label: YouTube
terms_note: Free; default project quota = 100 search.list calls + 100 videos.insert calls + 10,000 units/day for everything else (list 1 unit, insert/update/delete 50 units) — extension via the quota request form; videos uploaded by UNVERIFIED API projects created after 2020-07-28 are locked to private until the project passes the YouTube API Services compliance audit; OAuth scopes youtube.upload / youtube / youtube.force-ssl; YouTube API Services Terms apply (no artificial engagement).

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.endpoint: POST youtube/v3/comments (parentId) — 50 units · POST youtube/v3/commentThreads (top-level) — 50 units

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.endpoint: — (no mention feed; `search.list` on the brand name is the only proxy, 1 of 100 daily calls each)

tools.name: analytics_account
tools.endpoint: same reports endpoint with `ids=channel==MINE` (+ statistics on channels.list)

auth: 1. Google Cloud project → enable YouTube Data API v3 (+ Analytics API) → OAuth 2.0 web client.

endpoints.notes: `snippet{title, description, tags, categoryId}`, `status{privacyStatus, publishAt, selfDeclaredMadeForKids}`, ≤ 256 GB

reference.limits: - Default quota: 100 `search.list` calls + 100 `videos.insert` calls + 10,000 units/day for everything else (list 1, write 50); more via the quota extension form (needs the compliance audit). - YouTube API Services Terms + Developer Policies: no artificial inflation, keep data ≤ 30 days unless refreshed, show the YouTube ToS to users.

adapter.rate_note: Default quota 10,000 units per day: channels.list, commentThreads.list and videos.list cost 1 unit, comments.insert and videos.delete 50 units.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console, Clients page) of the app the user consented to.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth client's secret; sent with client_id, refresh_token and grant_type=refresh_token in the form body of POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token (https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#offline).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent with access_type=offline and the scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.force-ssl. 'Refresh tokens are valid until the user revokes access or the refresh token expires'; the runtime mints 1-hour access tokens from it.

me.note: channels.list?mine=true: account.items[0] is the authenticated user's channel (snippet, statistics).

read_comments.note: `post_id` is the video ID; returns top-level comments (1 quota unit). Pagination is by pageToken, so `page` is ignored. `id` is the top-level comment id to pass to reply_comment.

reply_comment.note: comments.insert 'Creates a reply to an existing comment' (50 quota units); `comment_id` is the top-level comment id.

delete.note: DESTRUCTIVE: videos.delete 'Deletes a YouTube video' (`post_id` = video ID, 50 quota units); answers 204.

analytics_post.note: videos.list?part=statistics: metrics carries viewCount, likeCount, favoriteCount, commentCount (strings). An unknown video id is `invalid_input`.

not_offered.publish_text: Community posts have no Data API method; the only publish method is videos.insert (https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videos/insert).
not_offered.publish_image: Images are only thumbnails: thumbnails.set is a media upload ('POST https://www.googleapis.com/upload/youtube/v3/thumbnails/set', https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/thumbnails/set) and videos.insert is a multipart/resumable upload; the runtime sends JSON bodies only.
not_offered.read_mentions: No mention feed exists; search.list on a name is only a keyword search (https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/search/list).

scopes youtube.force-ssl: all listed in the discovery document
